comments.body:
> Hi @Xichen96 - do you need a topo file change to add `vlan_configs`?
> 
> Can you share some test output?

@zjswhhh dualtor topo file should have included 3 sets of vlan configs for 1 vlan, 2 vlan and 4 vlan. And it has a default_vlan_config which is typically 1 vlan. I can't say for sure about other topos, but they shouldn't be our target. We do need a deployment change. In the previous version, even if we configured multivlan, the script assumes only one and all soc_ip are under 1 vlan. For testing purpose I changed soc_ip to be in different vlans.

Below is the dumped iptables rules under multivlan
